name: MDMAR
summary: 3',4'-Methylenedioxy-4-methylaminorex (MDMAR) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted aminorex family, with monoamine-releasing effects. It is a potent serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA).

pharmacology.text: It is a potent serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA).
